In this video, I travel from Delhi to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, via China. I flew from Delhi to Shanghai with Air India using China’s 24-hour visa-free transit policy, which allowed me to enter China without a visa. From Shanghai, I took Spring Airlines to Mongolia.
But things took a completely unexpected turn when I arrived in Mongolia. I was informed that the visa-on-arrival policy had been discontinued, and I was suddenly stuck at the airport without permission to enter the country.
